brief:
Israeli occupation authorities served an eviction notice on the al-Razem family in Qalandia village north of occupied Jerusalem on Sunday, citing a court decision, Shehab Wire reported. The Jerusalem Governorate confirmed the action was based on a judicial ruling ordering the evacuation of the residential building.

The notice marks another displacement order in the village, which lies in the northern reaches of the occupied West Bank near the checkpoint separating Jerusalem from surrounding Palestinian areas.

title: Israeli authorities order evacuation of Qalandia residential building north of Jerusalem
